indicator_definition: Proportion of the population who perceive courts as fairly or very independent. Reflects public trust in judicial institutions and rule of law. Data from EU Justice Scoreboard Eurobarometer surveys.
rationale: Trust in judicial independence is fundamental to the rule of law. Progress means an increasing proportion of citizens perceiving justice as independent.
methodology_characteristics: Data collected through annual Eurobarometer surveys. Respondents assess independence of courts from government and economic interests. Published in the EU Justice Scoreboard.
indicator_name: Perceived independence of the justice system
graph_title: Perceived independence of the justice system
